meta.layoutBasis: User-provided campus plan board, perspective rectified
meta.heightBasis: Visual relative-height estimate from 23 official images and official library floor-use notice, 2026-10-20. Some views are repeated, and ref17 is a published planning rendering, not a measured aerial survey. Unverified buildings remain low-confidence estimates. Refined using a public 2017 alumni drone video at 16 timestamps; old low-resolution footage is evidence for broad massing only.
meta.libraryShape: Regular symmetric ellipse, following user correction to the photographed plan board
meta.regularization: Axis-aligned rectangles and orthogonal L/C masses; symmetric ellipses; gym symmetric trapezoid
meta.heightUnits: approximate metres; schematic plan units are not surveyed metres
meta.massingBasis: Library bands and regular ellipse; gym barrel roof; administration open roof frame; dorm six-floor rhythm and roof racks. Ground footprints stay aligned with the user plan.
meta.userCorrections: 2026-10-20: two commercial ground zones, road clearance east of library, left-attached auditorium, ship-civil imported room aliases.
